; Remote Share home-screen toggle for reMarkable OS 3.28.0.172.
; Requires qt-resource-rebuilder and qt-command-executor from rm-xovi-extensions v19.

AFFECT [[13636194074538366841]]
	TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[6504254477]]
		LOCATE BEFORE ALL
		INSERT {
			property bool remoteShareOn: false
			property bool remoteShareBusy: false
			property bool remoteShareError: false
			property var remoteShareExpiryTimer: Qt.createQmlObject('import QtQuick 2.15; Timer { repeat: false; onTriggered: { parent.remoteShareOn = false; } }', root)
			property var remoteShareProbeTimer: Qt.createQmlObject('import QtQuick 2.15; Timer { interval: 1000; repeat: false; running: true; onTriggered: parent.refreshRemoteShareState(); }', root)

			function applyRemoteShareStatus(output) {
				if (output.indexOf("ON ") === 0) {
					root.remoteShareOn = true;
					root.remoteShareError = false;
					var match = output.match(/expires=([0-9]+)/);
					if (match) {
						var remaining = (parseInt(match[1], 10) * 1000) - Date.now();
						root.remoteShareExpiryTimer.interval = Math.max(1000, remaining);
						root.remoteShareExpiryTimer.restart();
					}
				} else if (output.indexOf("OFF") === 0) {
					root.remoteShareOn = false;
					root.remoteShareError = false;
					root.remoteShareExpiryTimer.stop();
				}
			}

			function runRemoteShareCommand(arguments, timeout, markBusy) {
				if (markBusy && root.remoteShareBusy) { return; }
				if (markBusy) { root.remoteShareBusy = true; }
				var exec = null;
				try {
					exec = Qt.createQmlObject("import net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0; AsyncCommandExecutor {}", root);
				} catch (error) {
					root.remoteShareBusy = false;
					root.remoteShareError = true;
					return;
				}
				exec.command = "/home/root/remote-share/remote-share-control";
				exec.arguments = arguments;
				exec.stdOutAvailable.connect(function(output) { root.applyRemoteShareStatus(output); });
				exec.runningChanged.connect(function() {
					if (!exec.running) {
						if (markBusy) { root.remoteShareBusy = false; }
						if (exec.exitCode !== 0) { root.remoteShareError = true; }
						exec.destroy();
					}
				});
				if (!exec.startCommand(timeout)) {
					if (markBusy) { root.remoteShareBusy = false; }
					root.remoteShareError = true;
					exec.destroy();
				}
			}

			function refreshRemoteShareState() {
				root.runRemoteShareCommand(["status-fast"], 5000, false);
			}

			function toggleRemoteShare() {
				root.remoteShareError = false;
				root.runRemoteShareCommand(["toggle"], 30000, true);
			}
		}

		TRAVERSE [[254501108490678590]]#[[16596251247453125840]] > [[254501558939456351]]#[[6391657810197849963]]
			LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT {
				~&7081201431623&~ {

					~&477346483278530855&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&6504391364&~

					~&12473595850146141341&~: [~&"233737316206498&~, ~&"7082656280847&~, ~&"7834776425552261693&~]
					~&5336234142035948531&~: ~&6504254477&~.toggleRemoteShare()
					~&233748328658231&~: remoteShareBut.~&12473595850146141341&~.~&7713146641368448&~(~&6504254477&~.~&6504391364&~)
					~&8399601734642709923&~: ~&6504254477&~.remoteShareBusy ? ~&"7424602933551009652&~ : (~&6504254477&~.remoteShareError ? ~&"18215817719560467479&~ : (~&6504254477&~.remoteShareOn ? ~&"3799445540336449548&~ : ~&"6968812125536432958&~))
				}
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
